items.title: To Infinity and Beyond: ThunderKittens Now on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72!
items.raw_text: We ported ThunderKittens to NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 and rebuilt our NVFP4 GEMM around the new hardware, taking it from 42% of roofline to over 22 PFLOPS — competitive with cuBLAS and CuTe DSL. Here is what changed in the ISA and how we used it.
items.reason_zh: ThunderKittens 移植到 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 并重构 NVFP4 GEMM，性能从 42% roofline 提升至 22 PFLOPS，深入 ISA 细节，对高性能计算开发者极具参考价值。
items.summary_zh: Together AI 将 ThunderKittens 移植到 NVIDIA 最新的 Vera Rubin NVL72 平台，并围绕新硬件重构了 NVFP4 GEMM 内核。优化后性能从 roofline 的 42% 提升至超过 22 PFLOPS，与 cuBLAS 和 CuTe DSL 相当。文章详细介绍了 ISA 的变化以及如何利用这些变化实现性能突破，为高性能 AI 计算开发者提供了宝贵的底层优化经验。
items.title_zh: 无限超越：ThunderKittens 现已登陆 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72！

items.title: Deep belief networks are exact
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.05572v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We prove that every strictly positive probability distribution on \(\{-1,1\}^n\) is represented exactly by a sigmoid belief network with finite parameters. This answers a question of Sutskever and Hinton. The proof upgrades their probability-sharing approximation to exact representation using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem.
items.reason_zh: 证明深度信念网络可精确表示任意严格正分布，回答 Sutskever 与 Hinton 的开放问题，理论价值高。
items.summary_zh: 该论文证明：定义在 {-1,1}^n 上的任意严格正概率分布，都可由参数有限的 sigmoid 信念网络精确表示。这回答了 Sutskever 与 Hinton 提出的一个开放问题。作者将两人此前的概率共享近似结果升级为精确表示，证明过程借助 Brouwer 不动点定理。该结果深化了对深度信念网络表达能力的理论理解，为无向/有向概率图模型的表示能力研究提供了新的严格结论。
items.title_zh: 深度信念网络是精确的

items.reason_zh: 探讨CoT监督失效与不透明串行深度，涉及AI可解释性与对齐监督的核心难题，思想深度高。
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了链式思维（CoT）作为监督AI模型工具的价值及其局限性。文章指出，尽管CoT目前是监督AI模型的重要手段，但存在“监督失效”（Loss of Oversight）的问题，并提出了“不透明串行深度”（opaque serial depth）的操作化概念。该研究聚焦于当模型内部推理过程变得不可观测时，如何维持对AI的有效监督，对AI可解释性与对齐研究具有重要理论意义。

items.title: From Concentration to Differentiation and Back: Routing Effective Rank in MoE Reasoning Cohorts
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.06403v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Test-time scaling produces cohorts of reasoning rollouts, yet there is no standard label-free account of how their internal computation reorganizes as inference unfolds. We introduce routing effective rank deff, the entropy-effective dimensionality of a cross-rollout graph built from MoE expert-routing similarity. Across ten MoE configurations and five math/science benchmarks, deff exhibits a reproducible low-high-low trajectory, with a prominent interior maximum in 98.5% of 3,105 model-question cohorts: routing similarity is concentrated early, maximally differentiated at intermediate budgets, and reconcentrated later, and the timing of this maximum varies systematically with architecture and reasoning effort. An exact decomposition separates cohort-wide common-mode mass from residual spectral dimensionality: common-mode reallocation accounts for about two thirds of the trajectory, while the residual spectrum contributes about one quart
items.reason_zh: 用路由有效秩刻画 MoE 推理轨迹内部计算重组，属可解释性机制研究，洞察可迁移。
items.summary_zh: 论文关注测试时扩展产生的成组推理轨迹，指出目前缺乏无标签方法来描述推理推进过程中内部计算如何重组。作者提出“路由有效秩”指标，即基于 MoE 专家路由相似度构建的跨轨迹图的熵有效维度。在十种 MoE 配置上，该指标刻画了推理轨迹从集中到分化再回归的过程，为理解 MoE 模型推理时的内部计算组织提供了新的可解释性视角。
items.title_zh: 从集中到分化再回归：MoE 推理队列中的路由有效秩

items.title: What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.05663v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). items.reason_zh: 基于两个真实生产系统长达数月的群体级记录，揭示 LLM 交易智能体的实际行为，数据罕见且有价值。
items.summary_zh: 本文呈现了自主语言模型交易智能体在生产环境中的连续、群体级测量记录，覆盖两个同源设计系统：DX Terminal Pro（3505 个用户出资金库，在 Base 链上交易真实 ETH 的 meme 币市场，为期 21 天）以及 DXAP 实时 alpha 舰队（500 至 599 个用户创建的智能体）。研究记录了这些智能体在真实资金环境下的行为模式、决策特征与表现，为理解 LLM 智能体在金融场景中的实际部署提供了罕见的实证数据。
items.title_zh: LLM 交易智能体在生产中究竟做什么：来自两个舰队的六个月群体级记录

items.reason_zh: 实测 4-bit 量化在 Agent 循环中的表现，揭示显存开销与性能损耗，实用性强。
items.summary_zh: 文章质疑 4-bit 量化“几乎无损”的说法，将其放入 Agent 循环中重新测试。作者首先详细计算 24GB 显卡的显存占用，逐一列出模型权重、KV 缓存、激活值等随上下文增长的开销，以 30B 稠密模型为例给出典型数值。随后在 Agent 多轮交互场景下评估 4-bit 量化的实际影响，可能涉及推理速度、输出质量、显存峰值和稳定性。结论指出量化在长上下文和复杂循环中可能带来不可忽视的精度损失或性能瓶颈。

items.title: 干与湿：AI 拿走脑力之后，人剩下什么

items.reason_zh: 从“干与湿”概念切入，反思 AI 拿走脑力后人的价值，有哲学深度和启发性。

items.title: Agent Evaluation Metric for multi-turn conversations
items.raw_text: Multi-turn agents fail in ways single-turn evaluation misses: one early mistake corrupts every later turn. This post introduces the Agent Evaluation Metric (AEM), a decomposable, turn-level way to measure agent quality, applied to its first dimension, correctness, to pinpoint the turn that caused a failure and separate it from the turns that inherited it.
items.reason_zh: 提出面向多轮对话的Agent评估指标AEM，可定位导致失败的具体轮次，对Agent开发者实用性强。
items.summary_zh: 多轮Agent的失败模式是单轮评估无法捕捉的：早期的一次错误会污染后续所有轮次。本文提出Agent Evaluation Metric（AEM），一种可分解、按轮次衡量的Agent质量评估方法，并首先应用于其正确性维度，用以精确定位引发失败的那一轮，并将其与继承该错误的后续轮次区分开来。该方法有助于开发者更准确地诊断多轮对话Agent的问题根源。
items.title_zh: 面向多轮对话的 Agent 评估指标
